    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.DOC = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM schools s
WHERE s.County = 'Orange'
  AND s.StatusType = 'Merged'
